note: This contract freezes the public ReLU-attention semantics; provenance and source-entry mappings are maintained outside the Agent package.
input: x of shape (B, S, C), not pre-split Q/K/V
projections: one fused in-projection to 3C, split into q/k/v; no out-projection is applied
mask: causal, top-left, applied before the activation
activation: ReLU on the masked scores, in place of Softmax
normalisation: none: there is no denominator, so the output is a plain weighted sum
causal_mask_buffer: the public execution model precomputes a (max_seqlen, max_seqlen) tril buffer; input length equals max_seqlen in every case

abi.note: runner is a ModelNew module evaluated in the same process as the public execution model

window.left: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the left
window.right: -1: this family applies no window, so every key is visible on the right

fully_masked_row.note: Cannot occur here: the top-left causal mask always exposes at least the query's own key. The zero convention is declared anyway so an unreachable case is not mistaken for an unconsidered one.

attention.note: No softmax in this family: the masked scores are rectified and multiplied by v, so there is no denominator to shift and §4.2's max-shift clause does not apply.
